title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
abstract: arXiv:2610.12638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Day-ahead electricity forecasts can help building operators schedule heating, ventilation, and other services around anticipated demand. Choosing a forecasting model also requires balancing accuracy with its forecast-time inputs, local training, and computational requirements.   We benchmark statistical, machine-learning, recurrent neural-network, and pretrained TimesFM models for a university building. We use chronological validation and evaluate all configurations on the same 57 test days, comparing accuracy across workdays, weekends, and holidays alongside local fitting and forecasting time. Weather covariates use retrospective observations.   TimesFM 3.0 with covariates achieves the lowest overall errors, reducing mean absolute error by approximately 43\% relative to weekly seasonal-naive forecasting. XGBoost remains competitive, although paired daily comparisons do not establish a clear mean-absolute-error advantage for TimesFM. T

translated_title: 面向大学建筑日前电力预测的机器学习与时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: 日前电力预测可以帮助建筑运营者根据预期需求来安排供暖、通风及其他服务。选择预测模型还需要在预测精度与其预测时所需输入、本地训练和计算需求之间进行权衡。我们针对一栋大学建筑，对统计模型、机器学习模型、循环神经网络模型以及预训练的TimesFM模型进行了基准测试。我们采用按时间顺序划分的验证方式，并在相同的57个测试日上评估所有配置，比较各模型在工作日、周末和节假日的精度，同时比较本地拟合与预测所需时间。天气协变量采用回溯观测数据。带协变量的TimesFM 3.0取得了最低的总体误差，与每周季节性朴素预测相比，平均绝对误差降低了约43%。XGBoost仍具有竞争力，尽管逐日配对比较并未证明TimesFM在平均绝对误差上具有明确优势。
tldr: 该研究在一栋大学建筑上对统计、机器学习、循环神经网络和预训练TimesFM等日前电力预测模型进行了统一基准测试，发现带协变量的TimesFM 3.0总体误差最低（平均绝对误差较每周季节性朴素预测降低约43%），而XGBoost仍具竞争力。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks statistical, machine-learning, recurrent neural-network, and pretrained TimesFM models for day-ahead electricity forecasting in a university building, finding that TimesFM 3.0 with covariates achieves the lowest overall errors (reducing MAE by about 43% versus weekly seasonal-naive forecasting), while XGBoost remains competitive.
